Name: Dark Wood Craftable Plus v1.3 for 1.3.x
Author: MasterWdd
Description:
[size=6][u]                                 Dark wood Craftables Plus                                      
[/u][/size][b]
This mod edits the fallowing items[/b]: Tapper, Cheese Press, Mayonaisse Machine, Bee House, Chest, Loom, Preserves Jar, Keg, Seed Maker, Oil Maker, Crystalarium, Recycling Machine, Lightning Rod, Wood Lamppost, Iron Lamppost, Cas, Charcool Kiln, Mushroom Box, Garden Pot, Stone Sign, Wood Sign, Furnace and 1 House Plant. [b]More items will come soon![/b]

Replaces craftables with darker version of it.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png[/img]


[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.3.X beta on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in single-player and multiplayer.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png[/img]


With [b]Content Patcher:[/b]
[b]   1.[/b]Unzip the file with your program of choice.
[b]   2.[/b]Put the folder Called [b]Dark Wood Craftable Plus [/b]in the [b]Mods[/b] folder.
[b]   3.[/b] Load up your game and enjoy!

Without [b]Content Patcher:[/b]
[b]   1. Backup your original files![/b]
[b]   2[/b]. Unzip the file with your program of choice
[b]   3[/b]. Copy and paste each XNB file into their corresponding folder--
[list]
[*]Craftables.xnb goes into Content > TileSheets
[*]springobjects.xnb goes into Content > Maps
[/list][b]   4.[/b] Load up your game and enjoy!
